A LITTLE CONTROL. A LOT OF CHAOS.

HOW TO RIOT.

MOVE. WASD or arrow keys. On a phone, drag the left side of the arena. Firing and aiming are automatic.

MULTIPLY. Space, Shift, or the dash button. You dodge damage and leave an echo that retraces your recent movement and fights for you.

EVOLVE. Blue energy fills your XP bar, boosts damage, and repairs hull as your rank rises. Endless offers an upgrade every 45 seconds on the run clock, including wave breaks. The countdown stops while paused or choosing an upgrade. Rush and Daily offer powers at 20, 45, and 70 seconds. CORES EARNED shows your current run payout, including wave and operative bonuses; finish or extract to bank it for permanent upgrades.

ERASE. Charge your nova by defeating enemies. Press Q or tap Nova to clear bullets and deal area damage.

OUTLAST. Rush clears unlock harder tiers and better rewards. Endless sends packs into finite waves with eight-second breaks. Elite wardens join the horde from wave 3; giant overlords arrive every fifth wave alongside normal enemies. Auto-aim tracks visible enemies. Yellow chargers telegraph a dash; violet hunters drain echoes. Survive 90 seconds in Rush or Daily. Bosses arrive along the way. Endless gets harder by wave, not by time. Extract between waves to finish with your earned cores. Defeat also pays your run rewards.

Esc / P pauses. Progress and cosmetics are saved on this device. Challenge codes are friendly competition, not a verified global leaderboard.
